stories.title: Find an existing starting point
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to search my existing resources so that I can find material suited to the learner.

stories.title: Describe my teaching offer
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to create a profile describing my teaching offer so that I can explain how I teach.

stories.title: Understand the desired outcome
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to read the learner’s brief so that I can understand what the lesson should help them do.

stories.title: Adapt one reusable lesson
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to adapt a reusable lesson to the learner’s level and goal so that I can prepare without starting over.

stories.title: Approve a checked lesson
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to review and approve a lesson version so that it meets my standards and unreviewed drafts remain unshared.

stories.title: Teach toward the learner’s goal
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to teach one personal lesson focused on the learner’s goal so that the session supports a useful outcome.

stories.title: Share an approved recap
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to approve and share a recap of the session so that the learner has a clear record of what we covered.

stories.title: Check whether material fits
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to judge whether existing material suits this learner so that I can choose a useful starting point.

stories.title: Keep control of my offer
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to revise how my teaching offer is presented so that the profile reflects my own approach.

stories.title: Identify the current difficulty
stories.story: As a teacher, I want the brief to explain what is difficult now so that I can focus preparation without extra administration.

stories.title: Preserve my teaching method
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to change reused material to fit my method so that reuse still produces a personal lesson.

stories.title: Correct unsuitable content
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to change unsuitable content or use my own material so that I can approve a lesson I trust.

stories.title: Change the plan as we teach
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to adapt the plan during the session so that the tools support the conversation and my judgment.

stories.title: Make the next focus clear
stories.story: As a teacher, I want the recap to show what to work on next so that follow-up stays useful without rewriting everything.

stories.title: Use suggestions by choice
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to use suggestions only when helpful so that assistance supports my lesson preparation and stays optional.

stories.title: Review every AI suggestion
stories.story: As a teacher, I want to change or reject an AI suggestion so that only material I have checked can enter the approved lesson.
